title: Search autocomplete
prompt: Design search autocomplete: as a user types into a search box, suggest the most likely completions.
hard_part: Sub-100 ms suggestions over huge query logs
key_points: Sized the suggestion corpus with numbers and kept it in memory (it fits on one node)
Used a trie with precomputed top-K per node, or a prefix-to-top-K key-value table
Split the system into an online serving path and an offline aggregation and build path
Rebuilt snapshots and swapped them atomically instead of updating in place, with a trending overlay for freshness
Cut latency with client debouncing, caching (browser and CDN) and regional servers
Ranked with recency decay, filtered blocked or private suggestions, and failed gracefully when down
